name: Memory and Attention Lab

props.text: Educational memory/visual-search activities — not a diagnostic test. Anonymous results stay in this session unless exported.

events.Click:
# Handle this designer control.
lab_cancel(self)
self.Feedback.configure(text='Trial stopped; no result recorded.')

props.text: Choose a task and press Start trial.

startup:
# No trial begins automatically; there are no names, accounts or background uploads.
self.timer = None
self.generation = 0
self.phase = 'idle'
self.levels = {'Memory':3,'Attention':6}
self.results = []
self.Mode.set('Memory')
self.Board.bind('<Button-1>',lambda event:lab_click(self,event))
self.Answer.bind('<Return>',lambda event:lab_submit(self))
self.Form1.protocol('WM_DELETE_WINDOW',lambda:lab_close(self))
lab_plot(self)
self.Form1.deiconify()
